senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. דּוּד)to flow over, boil.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 11a">Sot. 11ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>, expl. <he>זדו</he> (<cite ref="Exodus 18:11">Ex. XVIII, 11</cite>), v. <cite ref="B01359"><he>בָּשַׁל</he></cite>

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 69a:4">Snh. 69ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>יזיד</he> <cite ref="Exodus 21:14">Ex. XXI, 14</cite>) <he>איש מֵזִיד וכ׳</he> a man (adult) cooks (prepares semen virile) and begets; Y. ib. VIII, beg. 26ᵃ <he>משיָזִיד</he> from the time he prepares &c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: to plan evil, to act with premeditation, in full consciousness of doing wrong.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 69a:7">Sabb. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ בזה ובזה זו מֵזִיד וכ׳</he> if he acted in full consciousness of both (of its being a Sabbath day and of such a labor being forbidden on the Sabbath), that is the wilful sinner meant in the Law (punishable).
<cite ref="Shabbat 69a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>שגג … וה׳ במלאכה</he> if he labored under a mistake as to the Sabbath day, but was aware of the sinful nature of the labor (if done on the Sabbath).

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:22">Ex. R. s. 5</cite>, end; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="M00751"><he>מֵזִיד</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="M00751"><he>מְזִידָה</he></cite>, v. supra. Y. Sot. V, beg. 20ᵃ; a. fr.—<he>במֵ׳</he> if done wilfully, opp. <he>בשוגג</he>.
<cite ref="Beitzah 30a:9">Bets. 30ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מוטב … ואל יהיו מ׳</he> it is better that they be ignorant than that they know and transgress wilfully; a. fr.
